deep.summary_fa: بازی خاطره‌انگیز و شوتر محبوب آنریل تورنومنت ۲۰۰۴ (Unreal Tournament 2004) اکنون به طور کامل درون مرورگر وب قابل بازی است. این پروژه روی دامنه ut2004.dev پیاده‌سازی شده و امکان اجرای بدون نیاز به نصب بازی را فراهم کرده است. کاربران همچنین می‌توانند از طریق یک لیست سرور آنلاین مبتنی بر وب (Master List) به سرورهای چندنفره مبتنی بر وب‌آرتی‌سی (WebRTC) متصل شده و آنلاین بازی کنند.

scored.title: Software companies are trying to kill home computing?
Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
scored.summary: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. scored.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
scored.summary: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection.
